notes.title: Tiny Patch + Info Update
notes.content:
Menu Update
 - Social Links Added; Random Shaking Fixed

Window randomization added
 - Some windows are permanently open, which makes entering buildings a lot more easy :)

Outdated demo version removed
- A demo can still be accessed at the gamejolt page

Ability toggle fixes
Menu input fixes
Character body clipping fixes


Some news

The content (tutorial video) creator Matt Aspland, well-known in the unreal engine community and between starting game developers has given We Heist Too a try.

Take a look - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m_K--roGrTk&t=1578s


Next month will bless We Heist Too with a convenient sale, keep a watchful eye for that!





PRESSKIT FOR WE HEIST TOO: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1P7PAda7IOqJIoQSwZaegnUk22skIciDD/view?usp=drive_link
